names.description: Cloud names in full (not a Terraform variable; docs/design.md, "Names, labels and tags"). A name set here takes no prefix.

namePrefix.description: Optional convenience (not a Terraform variable): <namePrefix>- in front of every derived name. A DNS label. Empty changes nothing.

labels.description: Map of labels (fabric's labels): Kubernetes labels on every object; an unprefixed key also becomes a Google Cloud label (Config Connector copies it).

tags.description: Cloud labels on every resource (Google Cloud labels: lower-case letters, digits, _ and -).

iam.description: IAM bindings for the API in {ROLE => [MEMBERS]} format.

service_account_create.description: Flag indicating whether a service account needs to be created.

service_account_email.description: Service account for creating API configs.

spec.description: String with the contents of the OpenAPI spec.

deletion_policy.description: DELETE (default) or ABANDON (not a fabric variable).
